description: CFS10: 10-story Cold-Formed Steel Building Shake Table Program is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Tara Hutchinson, University of California San Diego (ucsd.edu). As a capstone to the multi-university-industry collaborative CFS-NHERI project, a full-scale 10-story building is constructed and tested under earthquake and live-fire scenarios at the NHERI 6-DOF Large High Performance Outdoor Shake Table (LHPOST6) facility. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Earthquake,  Fire , cold-formed steel, finishes, gravity walls, tall building systems. Published 2026-02-13. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
